lines.name: Sarah
lines.en: Hello! How can I help you today?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I think I caught a cold. I need some medicine.
lines.ko: 감기에 걸린 것 같아요. 약이 필요해요.

lines.name: Sarah
lines.en: Oh, I'm sorry to hear that. What are your symptoms? Do you have a fever or a sore throat?
lines.ko: 저런, 안됐네요. 증상이 어떠세요? 열이 나거나 목이 아프세요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I have a fever and a sore throat, and I feel drowsy.
lines.ko: 열이 나고 목이 아파요. 그리고 나른해요.

lines.name: Sarah
lines.en: Oh, you feel drowsy too. You should get some rest. How long have you had these symptoms?
lines.ko: 나른하기도 하시군요. 좀 쉬셔야겠어요. 증상은 언제부터 있었어요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: It started today. Yesterday, I went for a walk at night.

lines.name: Sarah
lines.en: I see. It was cold last night. Are you allergic to any medicine?
lines.ko: 그렇군요. 어젯밤 추웠죠. 알레르기 있는 약이 있나요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: No, I'm not allergic to any medicine.

lines.name: Sarah
lines.en: OK. This cold medicine is good for a fever and a sore throat. Take one tablet three times a day, after meals. And drink lots of warm water. Do you have any questions?
lines.ko: 네. 이 감기약이 열과 목 아픈 데 좋아요. 하루 세 번, 식후에 한 알씩 드세요. 따뜻한 물도 많이 드시고요. 궁금한 점 있으세요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: Does it make me drowsy? Is there anything good for a cold?
lines.ko: 먹으면 졸린가요? 감기에 좋은 게 있을까요?

lines.name: Sarah
lines.en: Yes, it may make you a little drowsy. So don't drive after you take it. For a cold, rest is the best. Sleep well, and eat warm soup. Anything else?
lines.ko: 네, 조금 졸릴 수 있어요. 그러니 드신 후에는 운전하지 마세요. 감기에는 쉬는 게 최고예요. 푹 자고 따뜻한 국물을 드세요. 더 필요한 건요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: Thank you for your kind help. As soon as I get home, I need to get some rest.
lines.ko: 친절하게 도와주셔서 감사해요. 집에 가자마자 좀 쉬어야겠어요.

lines.name: Sarah
lines.en: You're welcome! Get well soon. Take care!

vocab.example: Yesterday, I went for a walk at night.
Take one tablet three times a day, after meals.
